label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMON hide in tall grass like this, don't they? / I've never thrown a POKé BALL. Watch me and tell me if I do it right. / …Whoa!$

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
text: WALLY: I did it… It chose to stay. It's my POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
text: {PLAYER}, thank you! Let's go back to the GYM. I want your dad to see!$

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
text: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right into tall grass. / The grass goes up my nose and… Fwafwafwafwafwa… / Fwatchoo!$

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
text: I thought I saw a flower move... Then a little green POKéMON ran through the grass! / It was SHAYMIN! You can find it here already, before any GYM. / It's a 1% wild encounter. SWEET SCENT raises that chance to 25%.$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
text: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
text: ROUTE 102 {LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
text: … … … … … … … … … … … Beep! / DAD: Oh, {PLAYER}? / … … … … … … Where are you now? It sounds windy wherever you are. / I just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE about your POKéNAV, so I decided to give you a call. / It sounds like you're doing fine, so that's fine with me. / You take care now. / … … … … … … … … … … … Click!$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav
text: Registered DAD NORMAN in the POKéNAV.$

label: Route105_Text_DOMINIK_LocalConversation
text: I challenged the current. It swept the entire match.$

label: Route106_Text_TrainerTips
text: TRAINER TIPS / Advice on catching POKéMON with a ROD: Press the A Button if you get a bite.$

label: Route106_Text_DOUGLAS_LocalConversation
text: A LAPRAS ferry sounds relaxing. I should have booked one.$

label: Route107_Text_BETH_LocalConversation
text: I swim for the scenery. The scenery keeps splashing me.$

label: Route108_Text_JEROME_LocalConversation
text: I counted every wave out here. Then somebody used SURF.$

label: Route108_Text_MATTHEW_LocalConversation
text: MANTINE makes this look easy. I would also like some wings.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in SLATEPORT! / I suppose you're going to visit CAPT. STERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?$

label: Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestion
text: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed to deliver the DEVON GOODS. / Would you like to sail back to DEWFORD, then?$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs
text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then! / Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods
text: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in SLATEPORT! / You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime! / Now, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToSail
text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!$

label: Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot
text: Yo, TRAINERS! Whether you're hot to trot, or cool cat not, chill at my papa's spot!$

label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
text: Little kids can dart around so quickly… / You don't dare take your eyes off them for an instant. It's very taxing. / Mine are with my POKéMON, so they should be okay, but…$

label: Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime
text: Our sand castle's taking a long time to make.$

label: Route109_Text_YouCanHaveThis
text: You can have this!$

label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
text: We're going to get all the sand from the beach and make a big castle! / And then we're going to be a king and queen. / We'll let you be a servant.$

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
text: The water around these parts is clean. / But, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up litter from the shoreline at times. / Dirty water becomes rain and joins our rivers, which we drink from… / If we pollute the sea, it all comes back to haunt us eventually.$

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonCry
text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?$

label: Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign
text: SEASHORE HOUSE / “May hot battles rage on hot sands! The place for hot TRAINERS!”$

label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
text: TRAINER TIPS / Every partner has competitive potential. Battles do not award EVs to grind. / Use a CENTER specialist to set Nature and EVs. Compare the resulting stats before battle.$

label: Route109_Text_HUEY_LocalConversation
text: My sea legs are excellent. My land legs filed a complaint.$

label: Route109_Text_GWEN_LocalConversation
text: My float has never lost a race. It has never entered one either.$

label: Route109_Text_ELIJAH_LocalConversation
text: A bird overhead means good luck. Usually. Keep your hat on.$

label: Route112_Text_VialChanseyClimbed
text: Blob bounded toward JAGGED PASS. The trail continues up the mountain.$

label: Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing
text: Hey, man, is our leader really going to awaken that thing?$

label: Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite
text: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard we need a METEORITE to do it.$

label: Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallarbor
text: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest of the crew went out to FALLARBOR.$

label: Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilTheyreBack
text: You got it. And until they come back, we're not to let anyone pass, right.$

label: Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridge
text: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if I went down these ledges, it'd be no easy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign
text: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR “A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
text: MT. CHIMNEY / For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit, please take the CABLE CAR. / A newer carving points to FIERY PATH. A fiery guardian may answer a holder of the DYNAMO BADGE.$

label: Route112_Text_RouteSignLavaridge
text: ROUTE 112 {LEFT_ARROW} LAVARIDGE TOWN$

label: Route112_Text_CAROL_LocalConversation
text: The mountain is lovely today. My sandwich is now toast. / KOFFING takes to FIERY PATH better. Level it up there at Lv. 35 or higher for Galarian WEEZING. / Outside that cave, it evolves into the usual WEEZING.$

label: Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass
text: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a wondrous thing! / Take this volcanic ash here. It can be fashioned into glass.$

label: Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh
text: PAWNIARD leave little tracks in the ash. They become BISHARP at Lv. 52. / Let BISHARP hold a LEADER'S CREST, then level it up for KINGAMBIT. The crest is used up when it evolves. / The free Evolution Items archive has crests. Show a battle supplier your MEGA RING to open the archive.$

label: Route113_Text_RouteSign111
text: ROUTE 113 {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 111$

label: Route113_Text_RouteSignFallarbor
text: ROUTE 113 {LEFT_ARROW} FALLARBOR TOWN$

label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
text: TRAINER TIPS / You may register one of the KEY ITEMS in your BAG as SELECT. / Simply press SELECT to use the registered item conveniently.$

label: Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign
text: GLASS WORKSHOP “Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”$

label: Route114_Text_GoodRodOffer
text: These pools hide stronger partners than an OLD ROD can reach. Take my GOOD ROD?$

label: Route114_Text_GoodRodAdvice
text: A GOOD ROD opens another layer of each route's encounter pool. Try every shore.$

label: Route114_Text_GoodRodDeclined
text: Come back if you decide to explore what waits below the surface.$

label: Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis
text: All my POKéMON does is ROAR… No one dares to come near me… / I found this DRAGON SCALE nearby. Please, take it off my hands.$

label: Route114_Text_ExplainRoar
text: A Dragon Scale evolves Seadra. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: Route114_Text_Poochyena
text: Bow! Bowwow!$

label: Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign
text: METEOR FALLS RUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE$

label: Route114_Text_FossilManiacsHouseSign
text: FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE “Fossils from every era studied!”$

label: Route114_Text_LanettesHouse
text: LANETTE'S HOUSE$

label: Route114_Text_NANCY_LocalConversation
text: I packed for every weather. My bag weighs more than I do.$

label: Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWillAppear
text: The shifted tide exposed SEASPRAY CAVE along the lower shore. / Its first chamber is wet stone. The floor below is somehow frozen.$

label: Route115_Text_RouteSignRustboro
text: ROUTE 115 {DOWN_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

label: Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign
text: METEOR FALLS FALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE$

label: Route115_Text_NOB_1_LocalConversation
text: I punched a rock for training. The rock remains undefeated.$

label: Route115_Text_KYRA_LocalConversation
text: I race my own best time now. She is a very annoying rival.$

label: Route115_Text_HELENE_LocalConversation
text: My coach told me to loosen up. I dropped my entire backpack.$

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
text: Ohhh, what am I to do? / We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when we were jumped by an odd thug… / The scoundrel made off with my darling PEEKO! / Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!$

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
text: Nnn… Roar! / I want to dig that tunnel!$

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
text: Nnn… Roar! What's going on? / I was digging the tunnel without any tools when some goon ordered me out! / That tunnel's filled with POKéMON that react badly to loud noises. They could cause an uproar. / That's why we stopped using heavy equipment for tunneling… / I'm worried that the goon will do something stupid and startle the POKéMON into an uproar.$

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
text: Nnn… Roar! / That goofy goon hightailed it out of the tunnel! I can go back to digging!$

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
text: Oh! It's you! / You're that person who not only helped me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got back my stolen package and then even graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT! / CAPT. STERN informed us that the package arrived, too! / I thank you very, very much! / Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would shower you with gratitude and hail you as a hero! / For you, the most wonderful TRAINER, I bear good news! / Recently, our company developed a new kind of POKé BALL. / As a token of our appreciation, this is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!$

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
text: Our new POKé BALL will be available at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO. / Please do try it out! Thank you and bye-bye!$

label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
text: Your BAG is jam-packed. I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.$

label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
text: As a token of our appreciation for your delivering our package, I have a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our most wonderful TRAINER!$

label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindDuskStone
text: I dropped a dark stone with a purple gleam… / Can you help me find it?$

label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThatDuskStone
text: That DUSK STONE! May I see it for a second?$

label: Route116_Text_DuskStoneIsYours
text: Hmm… Mine bore a crescent scratch. This one is different. / It seems to have chosen you. Keep it-- some POKéMON evolve in its darkness.$

label: Route116_Text_DuskStoneAlreadyUsed
text: The purple gleam that was here is gone. / Perhaps a TRAINER found it and gave it purpose. I'll search on.$

label: Route116_Text_DuskStoneNotYetFound
text: A lovely DUSK STONE, but not the one gleaming somewhere along this path.$

label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
text: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
text: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF / “The tunnel project has been canceled.”$

label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
text: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE$

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
text: TRAINER TIPS / If you want to stop a POKéMON from evolving, press the B Button while it is trying to evolve. The startled POKéMON will stop. / This is called an evolution cancel.$

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
text: TRAINER TIPS / Your BAG has several POCKETS. / Items you obtain are automatically placed in the appropriate POCKETS. / No TRAINER can afford to be without a BAG of their own.$

label: Route116_Text_KAREN_1_LocalConversation
text: I studied type matchups all night. The quiz was on geography.$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
text: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. It's been a while. / There's something here that you can't see, right? / Now, if I were to use this device on the invisible obstacle… / No, no. Rather than describing it, I should just show you. That would be more fun. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?$

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
text: STEVEN: No? / I'll wait here, so you can get ready.$

label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?$

label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true power as a TRAINER!$

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
text: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE. / An invisible POKéMON became completely visible! / The startled POKéMON attacked!$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
text: STEVEN: I see… Your battle style is intriguing. / Your POKéMON have obviously grown since I first met you in DEWFORD. / I'd like you to have this DEVON SCOPE. / Who knows, there may be other concealed POKéMON.$

label: Route120_Text_DevonScopeSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the DEVON SCOPE was sent to your PC.$

label: Route120_Text_DevonScopeNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room, then speak to me again.$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}. / I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS who strive together. / WINONA is waiting in FORTREE. Earn her FEATHER BADGE, then the road east is yours. / Use the SCOPE on the obstacle outside her GYM. It should clear your way.$

label: Route120_Text_StevenFeatherGate
text: STEVEN: The road east can wait. / WINONA is ready to test you in FORTREE GYM. Return with her FEATHER BADGE. / The SCOPE will reveal the POKéMON blocking her GYM. Try it there.$

label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
text: Something unseeable is in the way. / Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE. / An invisible POKéMON became completely visible! / The startled POKéMON attacked!$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree
text: ROUTE 120: FORTREE CITY to the west. / With the BALANCE BADGE, MESPRIT and OGERPON can appear in this route's grass. / The FEATHER BADGE adds XERNEAS and Galarian ARTICUNO. / Each is a 1% encounter. SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of an available legendary, shared evenly.$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSign121
text: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120$

label: Route120_Text_ROBERT_1_LocalConversation
text: My bird knows the way home. I am trying not to look jealous.$

label: Route120_Text_KEIGO_LocalConversation
text: You cannot see a true ninja. Please pretend you cannot see me.$

label: Route120_Text_RILEY_LocalConversation
text: I practiced hiding in the grass. The grass had other occupants.$

label: Route120_Text_CALLIE_LocalConversation
text: Every good partner needs a break. Mine insisted I take one first.$

label: Route126_Text_LEONARDO_LocalConversation
text: I was racing a FLOATZEL. Now I am enjoying a quiet swim.$

label: Route126_Text_ISOBEL_LocalConversation
text: My warm-up was a little long. I think I crossed a time zone.$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
text: ARCHIE: What happened… What is this wretched scene… / Did I…make a horrible mistake?$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
text: I… I only wanted…$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
text: MAXIE: Do you understand now, ARCHIE? / Do you finally see how disastrous your dream turned out to be? / We have to hurry! We have to do something before the situation goes completely out of control!$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResponsibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything. / I know that I have no right to be critical of ARCHIE… / But the way things are now, I doubt that we humans will be capable of doing anything about it. / But neither can we stand by and just watch helplessly. / The responsibility for putting an end to this falls to ARCHIE and me…$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
text: MAXIE: This defies belief… / Those super-ancient POKéMON… / Their power is unbelievable. They've upset the balance of nature…$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! What is happening?$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
text: This is terrible… / After the scorching heat wave ended, this deluge began. / If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… No, the whole world will drown. / This huge rain cloud is spreading from above SOOTOPOLIS… / What in the world is taking place there? / There's no point arguing here… SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…$

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
text: STEVEN: SURF north to ROUTE 127, then west to ROUTE 126's white crater. / Use DIVE along its southern wall. Enter the cavern and surface inside. / Meet me in SOOTOPOLIS. We must find the source of this storm.$

label: Route128_Text_WAYNE_LocalConversation
text: DHELMISE is not fishing tackle. Important lesson. Expensive rod.$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
text: We do all right in the preliminary round, but we can never win the appeals… / Maybe it means I have to watch what other contestants are doing…$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
text: See! My POKéMON won all these RIBBONS! / Have your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS? You can check them on your POKéNAV.$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
text: I can't beat GYM LEADERS… / I can't win any CONTESTS… / I've been here, there, and everywhere, and it's all for naught…$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_SuperRankStage
text: POKéMON CONTESTS SUPER RANK STAGE!$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
text: Oh, hello. You are? / Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}. I can see that you're a TRAINER. / So that means you use the POKéMON Storage System I developed. / How I arrived at that conclusion is a simple deductive process. / You spoke to me because you wanted to access something on this PC. / Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE. / Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's great you're using the Storage System. / If you could, please visit me at home. My house is on ROUTE 114.$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
text: I wonder what POKéMON looked like long, long ago? / Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge of town will know.$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
text: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant seedlings of hardy trees that thrive even in volcanic ash.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_IvyEvieIntro1
text: Hey there, TRAINER! / If you want your POKéMON to be the very best in all of HOENN, you've come to the right place! / I'm EVIE, and this is my sister, IVY.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_IvyEvieIntro2
text: IVY: We run the training programs that seriously beef up your team!$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_IvyEvieIntro3
text: EVIE: And these days it's all free. / IVY tunes EVs, and I trade HEART SCALES for PP UPS. / Come back as often as you like!$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheScaleCollector
text: I'm a HEART SCALE collector. / The tutors at every POKéMON CENTER already teach moves for free. / I polish HEART SCALES into PP UPS, one for one.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TradeScaleForPPUp
text: Trade one HEART SCALE for one PP UP?$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ExchangeComplete
text: A fine trade! I can polish another HEART SCALE whenever you're ready.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_BringHeartScale
text: Bring me a HEART SCALE and I'll trade you a PP UP.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_NoRoomForPPUp
text: Your BAG has no room for a PP UP. Make space before we trade.$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_MaybeLater
text: No rush. Your HEART SCALE stays safe with you until you're ready.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
text: Natures change stats, not which moves your Pokémon will obey. / You command both partners here. A quiet Pokémon can have a very aggressive battle set.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
text: My big sister is gentle usually. But when she gets angry, she's really, really scary! / I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary if it gets angry!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
text: My feelings toward my POKéMON… The attraction runs deep… / Oh, hi! A bond like yours deserves this SHINY STONE.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
text: My feelings toward my POKéMON… I'm sure the attraction is mutual! / They battle exactly the way I want them to!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
text: What kind of moves have you taught your POKéMON? / I think you would give yourself an advantage if they knew how to heal or protect themselves.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
text: SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I thought I might see you here. / A BATTLE TENT's a place where you can meet tough TRAINERS. / It doesn't matter what the rules are, or how battles are waged, either. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do the best you can!$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
text: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes of seeing tough TRAINERS in action in whatever the situation.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionWelcome
text: Bring a team that supports each partner through a hard match. / This is a six-Pokémon doubles exhibition. You command every move and switch. / Your team uses the current cap. Difficulty sets opponent levels. Enter with six healthy partners?$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionRules
text: LOCAL DOUBLES EXHIBITIONS / Bring six healthy Pokémon, with no Eggs. Prepare freely before entering. / Three victories earn one local prize. Your party is restored after each exhibition. / These results are separate from the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT. You return to this lobby afterward.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
text: WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm not feeling down anymore. / Because I have a new purpose in life. Together with my RALTS, I'm going to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become a great TRAINER. / Please watch me, {PLAYER}. I'm going to be stronger than you. / When I do, I'm going to challenge you to another battle.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeechShort
text: WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}. I'm going to get stronger than you. / When I do, I'm going to challenge you to another battle.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNextDoor
text: UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! WALLY's next door. / But, boy, there's something I have to tell you. / This natural environment is doing wonders for WALLY's health. / Maybe it's not just the environment. It could be POKéMON that are giving the boy hope.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySlippedOff
text: WALLY's gone away… He slipped off on his own…$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGoneThatFar
text: UNCLE: Is that right? WALLY's gone away that far all by himself… / Well, I have to give him credit--he is my little brother's son.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWanda
text: WANDA: You are? Oh, right, I get it! / You're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was telling me about. / I'm WALLY's cousin. Glad to meet you! / I think WALLY's become a lot more lively and healthy since he came here.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorryAboutWally
text: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY. He'll be just fine. / I know my little cousin, and he has POKéMON with him, too.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGirlfriendEveryDay
text: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend every day. Happy? You bet I am!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendDriven
text: My daughter's boyfriend is a very driven and passionate sort of person. / He's been digging a tunnel nonstop just so he can see my daughter. / My daughter's a little concerned, so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendWasDigging
text: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend was digging the tunnel by hand! / It's so incredible!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythingHappenedToWally
text: If anything were to happen to WALLY, I would never be able to look his parents in PETALBURG in the eye…$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWasInEverGrande
text: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE? / His parents in PETALBURG would be astonished to hear that!$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_EventScript_MegaGift_GARDEVOIRITE_Text
text: Wally and his Ralts have given each other the courage to grow. / If you raise a Gardevoir, this stone can deepen that partnership.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
text: In the HOENN region, there are three POKéMON that represent the power of rock, ice, and steel. / Each of them is said to hide away deep inside caves. / That's the story I heard when I was just a little kid.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
text: “Six dots open three doors.” / Grandpa used to say that, but I don't know what he meant.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTradeIt
text: Check out this {STR_VAR_2}! / It's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught yesterday to celebrate my birthday! / Oh, I can see that you want it! After all, it's priceless! / I'll tell you what. I might be willing to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDifferentThankYou
text: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}? / It's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2}, and yet it's subtly different. / My {STR_VAR_2} is already trained for doubles. Ride it well!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAnyLessThanRealMon
text: No, no, no! I won't accept any less than a real {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateOrAnything
text: Oh, so you're not going to go through with this? / That's cool. I'm not desperate to make a trade or anything.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedToGetBagon
text: I know I could go looking for one on my own, but… / But I really wanted to get a BAGON that another TRAINER caught…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokedex
text: Is that a POKéDEX? / Did you get to meet a lot of different POKéMON? / I wish I was like you.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirageIslandToday
text: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageIslandToday
text: Oh! Oh my! I can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandAppearDependingOnWeather
text: MIRAGE ISLAND… / It must become visible and invisible depending on the weather conditions that make mirages appear. / Or is it really appearing and disappearing?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
text: Want a tasty little bit of advice for CONTESTS? / Using a certain move after another certain kind of move sometimes gets you extra attention. / If you know what you're doing, you can score big in appeal. / Of course, your opponents might try disrupting your POKéMON's showing.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
text: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE. / I wonder what I should be when I grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
text: Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed, you know. Like, you know, I just wanted to know why my POKéMON never won, you know, like, hey? / So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two cents, you know, they're free. / And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man! / Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
text: That move the tutor teaches, like, TORMENT? You hearing me? / Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see? / Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
text: MC: Oh, my, my! Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON? / Please! Do step right up and take part in our splendid CONTESTS! / You'll do well! I'm sure of it! My eyes have never failed me!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
text: JUDGE: Well, hello there! I see that you're a TRAINER! / Then, it just wouldn't do for you to miss a POKéMON CONTEST! / Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF CITY and enter anytime!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
text: It's appeal time! What should I lead with?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
text: They didn't pay much attention to my POKéMON's appeal… / Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know a good thing when he sees it.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
text: Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get this close to the action. / I'll reward your enthusiasm with this sage advice. / If a move goes over really well, the audience will get excited. / The POKéMON that makes its appeal right when everyone's excited… / Well, you'd think something good has to happen!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
text: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out than my POKéMON. / I'm shivering and my heart is racing!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
text: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the same, but they are alike, too. / You need to work hard and believe in the POKéMON you've raised.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
text: That POKéMON looks like it's on top of its game, huh? / A POKéMON that does good in the secondary judging seems to be more relaxed when it's doing appeals.$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
text: Will you look at that sorry sight? / Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better than that lot!$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
text: Don't you get the urge to move with POKéMON if they're putting on an energetic appeal?$

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
text: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
text: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature. / It has higher SPEED compared to my other POKéMON. / Maybe their nature has something to do with the stat gains of POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
text: You're a TRAINER, aren't you? / Since you came to SLATEPORT CITY, you must be going to the BATTLE TENT.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
text: Want a tip for battling? / I'd say it's raising different kinds of POKéMON in a balanced manner. / It's no good to make just one POKéMON strong. / If it has a type disadvantage, it might not stand a chance.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
text: I trade POKéMON with my friends. / If a traded POKéMON is holding an item, it makes me twice as happy!$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_MarketAndMartStockDifferentGoods
text: The MARKET has unusual merchandise. / The MART is still a reliable place to restock everyday field supplies.$

label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBetter
text: A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL at catching POKéMON. / With this, I should be able to get that elusive POKéMON…$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
text: Well, well, what have we here? A most energetic customer! / Me? You may call me RYDEL. I'm the owner of this cycle shop.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
text: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES… They're awfully filthy. / Did you come from far away?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
text: RYDEL: Is that right? / Then, I guess you have no need for any of my BIKES.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
text: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … … / You're saying that you came all this way from LITTLEROOT? / My goodness! That's ridiculously far! / If you had one of my BIKES, you could go anywhere easily while feeling the gentle caress of the wind! / I'll tell you what! I'll give you a BIKE! / Oh, wait a second! / I forgot to tell you that there are two kinds of BIKES! / They are the MACH BIKE and the ACRO BIKE! / The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want to feel the wind with their bodies! / And an ACRO BIKE is for those who prefer technical rides! / I'm a real sweetheart, so you can have whichever one you like! / Which one will you choose?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
text: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
text: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch BIKES, just come see me!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about switching BIKES?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: Okay, no problem! I'll switch BIKES for you!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
text: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged for an ACRO BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
text: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged for a MACH BIKE.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
text: RYDEL: Good, good! I'm happy that you like it!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
text: Oh? What happened to that BIKE I gave you? / Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC. / Well, take it out of PC storage, and I'll be happy to exchange it! / May the wind always be at your back on your adventure!$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
text: I'm learning about BIKES while I work here. / If you need advice on how to ride your BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in the back.$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
text: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE. / Which page do you want to read?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
text: A BIKE moves in the direction that the + Control Pad is pressed. / It will speed up once it gets rolling. / To stop, release the + Control Pad. The BIKE will slow to a stop. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
text: A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't stop very quickly. / It gets a little tricky to get around a corner. / Release the + Control Pad a little before the corner and slow down. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
text: There are small sandy slopes throughout the HOENN region. / The loose, crumbly sand makes it impossible to climb normally. / But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can zip up a sandy slope. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
text: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE. / Which page do you want to read?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
text: Press the B Button while riding, and the front wheel lifts up. / You can zip around with the front wheel up using the + Control Pad. / This technique is called a wheelie. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
text: Keeping the B Button pressed, your BIKE can hop on the spot. / This technique is called a bunny hop. / You can ride while hopping, too. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
text: Press the B Button and the + Control Pad at the same time to jump. / Press the + Control Pad to the side to jump sideways. / Press it backwards to make the BIKE change directions while jumping. / Want to read a different page?$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: I studied the PLEDGE moves and the three ultimate starter techniques. / The POKéMON CENTER specialist can teach all six now, free of charge.$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
text: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to SLATEPORT for some shopping. / I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
text: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL? Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
text: Oh, I'm so happy! Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
text: That COIN CASE can be used at the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
text: Oh, that's disappointing. / A COIN CASE is needed for the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_EventScript_MegaGift_AMPHAROSITE_Text
text: An Ampharos can light a road for everyone following behind it. / Take this stone. A strong partner can help others find their way.$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
text: That man over there, he says weird things! / He's funny in a weird way. I doubt I'll forget about him!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
text: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER, the data for what's hot in DEWFORD got updated. / Now that bit of data is the same as my friend's!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
text: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in the POKéMON CENTER. / I don't know what it's about, but it sounds fun. I'll go check it out!$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
text: Did you know that you can link battle at the COLOSSEUM here? / They put up your record on the wall for everyone to see. / It's embarrassing if you lose more often than you win…$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
text: Trainer battles do not allow BAG items. This shop stocks specialized POKé BALLS instead, so you can build more teams.$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
text: Choose a move, switch a partner, or protect a position… / The TRAINER's decisions determine how battles turn out.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
text: Hm, so they doubled the guests by using POKéMON as attractions? / Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute POKéMON our inn's mascot. / I wonder if that will attract more guests to stay with us?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
text: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV! / Since that TEAM AQUA came to town, the tourists have been staying away.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
text: Hey, down in front! I can't see the TV!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
text: Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON found someone's lost item? / That's something. If we had some smart POKéMON like that… / We could recover anything that our guests mislaid…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
text: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV! / I heard that someone busted the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT. / Thanks to that, we just booked a reservation from a big group. / It was a company called… Uh… GAME something…$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
text: Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON caught a burglar? / That's something. If we had a tough POKéMON as a security guard… / We would be able to provide our guests with greater safety.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
text: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV. / Oh, yes. A big group of guests arrived a little while ago. / They booked in as GAME FREAK, so I guess they must make games. / Uh-oh, I'd better get working on their dinner!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
text: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM. / Please take the time to enjoy our collection of fantastic artwork featuring POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
text: I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of fine arts. / It's heartening to see someone so young as you in our MUSEUM. / Have you viewed our collection of paintings already?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
text: Ah, then let me not disturb you. Please, do take your time.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
text: Oh? I do believe that you seem to be a POKéMON TRAINER. / Have you an interest in paintings, too?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
text: I see… / I'm honored that you would visit us in spite of that.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
text: Ah, excellent! You do like paintings! / Then, may I ask you to come with me?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
text: It's a very old painting. The paint is peeling here and there.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
text: It's an odd landscape with bizarre and fantastic scenery.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
text: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling woman with a POKéMON on her lap.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
text: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON from long ago. / The artist painted this from imagination.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
text: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON swaying in a breeze. / They appear to be enjoying the wind's gentle caress.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
text: It's a delicious-looking painting of BERRIES. / This painting could make you hungry!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
text: It's a replica of a famous sculpture. / It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
text: It's a big POKé BALL carved from a black stone. / It was apparently used in festivals in the olden days.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
text: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed with POKéMON and dense text in the small characters of an ancient, unreadable language.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
text: Hmmm… What works of great magnificence…$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
text: Battling with POKéMON is fun, I'll grant you that. / But one mustn't forget our love for the fine arts.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
text: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could see many fantastic paintings. / And the CURATOR is a wonderful person. / Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM is an inspiration.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
text: This lady is pretty! She's like Mommy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
text: This POKéMON is adorable! Just like our little boy!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
text: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got in some new paintings. / So, naturally I hurried over. / Are the new paintings up on the second floor?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
text: Lately, the CURATOR has been unusually cheerful. / I bet something good happened for him. Definitely.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
text: I aim to see many great paintings here and learn from them. / I have this dream of one day having my artwork exhibited here.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
text: The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite tourist destination. / It's great for LILYCOVE… No, great for the HOENN region! / This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER procured all the paintings upstairs.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
text: Yippee! / The lady at the reception counter gave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
text: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there. / When you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone has to put in a different BERRY.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
text: Congratulations! / I did a painting of your POKéMON to commemorate its victory… / Well, your POKéMON's appeals were so fantastic, it spurred me into painting better than I usually do. Look, see?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
text: What do you think? I'm confident in what I've done, but do you like it? / A work of this caliber, it wouldn't look out of place in an art museum. / Huh? An art museum really is looking for paintings? / Do you think I should take this there?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
text: What, really? Then, sure, I will take this painting there right now. / I'll give it a proper title, too. / I hope they'll like it and consider exhibiting this. / Please check if they did accept this. Thank you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
text: Oh, that's right! / As a memento of me painting your POKéMON, please take this.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon
text: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon
text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou
text: Okay, see you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
text: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take this home with me… / But, you know, I would like to take this to the art museum… Okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
text: Oh, fine, that's the way it is. I will hang this in my own house. / I'll just have to try harder next time. Well, be seeing you.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
text: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS, here I come. / The world will know that my dearest POKéMON is the cutest being in all existence. The time has come! Uheheheh.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
text: You can see a whole variety of POKéMON here. / That's why I make this place a regular part of my daily stroll.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
text: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is a feast for these eyes! / Would you look at all the POKéMON that just scream to be painted?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
text: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like extreme, man! / Those muscular appeals… Cascading sweat… I swoon!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
text: Day in and day out, I lavished my care on this POKéMON. / Its condition is peaking. Today, victory is mine!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
text: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and Big Sister. They turned out great! / I bet you can make smoother, better {POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
text: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON there are in the world. / It'd be great to cross seas and trade POKéMON with people far away.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardAboutRottenScoundrels
text: I've been hearing about some rotten scoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip off METEORITES.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaventSeenRottenScoundrels
text: Those rotten scoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip off METEORITES… / I haven't seen them around recently.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWowItsPlayer
text: Oh, wow! It's {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HeardAboutYouImYourFan
text: I've heard the news! You're really strong, aren't you? / We always argue about who is the strongest of all TRAINERS here. / So when I heard about you, I decided to be your fan! / I hope you'll keep on battling other tough TRAINERS. / That way, we'll be able to see more of your hot, hot battles. / That will make the others here see exactly how great you are. / Remember, I'm cheering for you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureOneWeWantToWin
text: Yo, {PLAYER}! You're the one we want to win!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OthersDontKnowYoureTheBest
text: The others, they don't know that you're the best of the best! / Isn't that right, {PLAYER}? Show them you've got guts!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersPowerIsOutOfTheOrdinary
text: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER everybody's talking about is {STR_VAR_1}, no question about it! / That TRAINER's power… It's out of the ordinary.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsBestNoOneWantsToListen
text: Darn it… I've been telling people that {STR_VAR_1} is the best now… / But no one wants to listen…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HearingAboutToughNewTrainer
text: I've been hearing things about a tough new TRAINER. / This TRAINER's supposed to be beating GYM LEADERS, even. / Do you know anything about this new TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImPullingForYou
text: Oh! {PLAYER}! / Go for it! I'm pulling for you!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrawlyNoImYourFan
text: Sigh… BRAWLY… / Oh, no! Wait! That's not right! No, no, no! / I'm your fan through and through! / So make me proud! Go for it!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ICantHelpLikingBrawly
text: I can't help it, I can only get to like BRAWLY…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NobodyUnderstandsBrawly
text: Nobody understands the charm of BRAWLY… / I don't care! / Even if I'm the only one, I'm going to keep cheering for BRAWLY!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_MyFavoriteTrainerIsBrawly
text: Whatever anyone says, my favorite TRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveSurpassedYourFather
text: You've surpassed your own father in every regard! / I'm telling you, so there's no question about it at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourFatherNeverGaveUpSoKeepOnBattling
text: Even when things turned bleak, your father never gave up. / This I know to be true. / You never give up even if you lose! So keep on battling!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LongWayToGoComparedToNorman
text: NORMAN battled with more power, charisma, and showmanship than you. / Even though people may say that you're strong… / You've still got a long way to go compared to your father.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouAndNormanAreDifferent
text: You're beginning to get the same air of awe NORMAN exudes. / But there's something conclusively different between you and NORMAN. / I can't tell you what that is. You'll have to find it yourself.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WeDiscussStrongestTrainers
text: Everyone here, we're all huge fans of POKéMON battles. / We discuss who we consider to be the strongest of all TRAINERS. / If you were to become famous, we might even become your fans!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWoweeItsPlayer
text: Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}! For real, too! / Please, shake my hand, shake my hand!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
text: I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}! Always, always! / I don't want to see you lose ever, {PLAYER}. / Because I know you're really, really strong, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneThinksTrainerIsCool
text: {STR_VAR_1} is really cool… / Everyone thinks so, right, right?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsReallyCoolItsJustMe
text: {STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't you think so? / Even if it's just me, I'm going to keep cheering my favorite TRAINER.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WishThereWasTrainerLikeThat
text: My favorite TRAINER is… / Cool… / Strong… / And really nice… / I wish there was a TRAINER like that…$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeStrongLikeYou
text: Whoa! It's {PLAYER}! Wicked! / When I grow up, I want to be strong like you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyOneWhoCheersForYou
text: Even if I'm the only one… / You'll always be the only one I cheer for, {PLAYER}! / Because I believe in you, {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsWickedlyCool
text: {STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool… I want to shake hands with my hero.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverGoingToStopBeingTrainersFan
text: Even if I'm the only one… / I'm never going to stop being {STR_VAR_1}'s fan! / Because I've heard, {STR_VAR_1} never loses!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureAmazingAfterAll
text: {PLAYER}! You are amazing after all! / Ever since I set eyes on you, I knew that you were great. / It looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImInYourCorner
text: Who cares about the others. I'm in your corner! / You don't need to worry. Just get out there and battle like always.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ThinkTrainerIsNumberOne
text: You're a pretty decent TRAINER, I think. / But I also think that {STR_VAR_1} is number one right now. / That's just my opinion. Don't worry about it too much.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureMaybeStrongerThanTrainer
text: Wow, you really are strong. Maybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}. / But {STR_VAR_1} needs me. / If I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1}, who will?$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouChangedMyMind
text: You've changed my mind! You are strong, aren't you? / I'd like you to tell me how you managed to get so strong!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouBattleAttractivelyInToughSituation
text: The tougher the situation, the more attractively you battle. / I can't wait for your next battle!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsStandout
text: Among the recently hot TRAINERS, {STR_VAR_1} is the standout. / That toughness, it's simply not normal. / You're doing okay, but you're not in the same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NoOneCanKnockYouButTrainerStronger
text: You are really popular… / You're strong, and you're caring to POKéMON. No one can knock you. / But, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}. / {STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger! I'm positive!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouImpressive
text: You… / Impressive!$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyIRecognizeYourTrueWorth
text: Your true worth, it is fine if only I recognized it. / The others I doubt will understand the hidden power that beats within.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HaventRealizedPotential
text: Yes, I see strength in your eyes. / But! / You still haven't realized your potential.$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
text: It is true that you are tremendously powerful. / But! I can tell… / That strength cannot be considered true strength yet! / True strength is…! … … / Actually, I have no idea, either.$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
text: This planet's biggest mysteries are at the bottom of the sea. / Somebody said that, but I don't know…$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
text: There's a deep underwater trench between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS. / That's what someone told me, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_EventScript_MegaGift_LAPRASITE_Text
text: A Lapras once carried my family home through a terrible storm. / I kept this stone in gratitude. Please find a Lapras to give it to.$

label: LilycoveCity_House4_EventScript_MegaGift_STARMINITE_Text
text: The sea leaves more than shells on our shore after a storm. / This stone shines like a Starmie. Let one carry it beneath the stars.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LearnToUseItemsProperly
text: Learn to use items properly. That's basic, really.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_GoodGiftForHusband
text: My husband is waiting at home. What would make a good gift for him?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems
text: I'm leaving on a long journey soon. I need to stock up on items.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RightBallBuildsTeamsFast
text: For building a new team quickly, the right kind of BALL is best. / QUICK BALLS reward a fast throw, while DUSK BALLS shine in caves.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_TimerBallsRewardPatience
text: Some rare POKéMON take patience. / A TIMER BALL grows stronger as the battle lasts, so I always carry a few.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_QuickBallFirstTurnCatch
text: I caught a new partner with a QUICK BALL on the very first turn!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefense
text: Hmm… / Immediate pressure… Or a defensive answer… / A good set needs four moves that solve one plan without becoming predictable.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_ManyDifferentMoves
text: There are so many different kinds of moves. / The POKéMON CENTER tutor can teach every move a species may legally learn.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
text: A POKéMON learns only four moves. / Changing one can change the role of the whole team.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_ClerkMoves
text: Every POKéMON CENTER has a tutor who teaches legal moves without charging. / Experiment freely. No TM purchase is needed.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_ClerkSets
text: The CENTER tutor also applies complete competitive sets: moves, Nature, Ability, EVs, and held item. / Mega sets still require the matching stone from your adventure.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HmmYourPokemon
text: Hmm! Your {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
text: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S, doesn't it? / No, I'm positive of it! It definitely likes {STR_VAR_1}S!$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
text: It doesn't appear to like or dislike any {POKEBLOCK}S.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
text: My husband can tell what kind of {POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance. / CYNTHIA is our guest while she studies MOSSDEEP's myths and meteor records.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaChallenge
text: I'm CYNTHIA. I study myths, but battles reveal how a Trainer reasons under fire. / You are HOENN's Champion. Will you face a Champion from another region?$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaDefeat
text: You removed the shelter, denied sleep, and still saved an answer for GARCHOMP.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaAfter
text: Take this SHINY CHARM. Let your next journey reveal something extraordinary.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaNotReady
text: These kind hosts gave me a quiet place to study HOENN's meteor records. / Your journey continues. Return after the HOENN LEAGUE knows your name.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaDecline
text: A good challenge improves by waiting.$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaBagFull
text: Make room for the SHINY CHARM. I will keep it safe.$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
text: Hey there, TRAINER! A SUPER ROD really is super! / Say all you want, but this baby can catch POKéMON off the seafloor! / What do you think? You want it, don't you?$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper
text: You bet, you bet! After all, a SUPER ROD is really super!$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodInWater
text: If there's any water, try dropping in your ROD and see what bites!$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
text: Hunh? Don't you like to fish?$

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloorPokemon
text: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with your SUPER ROD.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
text: My little brother says he likes to go find people's SECRET BASES.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
text: My little brother says he likes to visit people's SECRET BASES and have POKéMON battles.$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
text: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
text: You should make a SECRET BASE somewhere. I'll go find it!$

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Miyaan?$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreeting
text: When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER. / Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door appears to be locked.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is visiting my home. / Would you like to challenge {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle
text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
text: Oh, good, good! / But my house isn't all that sturdy. / Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgress
text: Before you two battle, you should save your progress.$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoodMatch
text: I hope to see a good match!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie
text: So, it became a standoff. / It was a brilliant match in which neither side conceded a step!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon
text: That was superlative! / Why, it was like seeing myself in my youth again!$

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost
text: Ah, too bad for you! / But it was a good match. I hope you can win next time.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
text: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass! Wait up, PEEKO!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
text: Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}! You saved my darling PEEKO! We owe so much to you! / What's that? You want to sail with me? / Hmhm… / You have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD and a package for SLATEPORT, then? / Quite the busy life you must lead! / But, certainly, what you're asking is no problem at all. / You've come to the right man! We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then! / Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? Your deliveries can wait? / You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say! / You're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD and a package to SLATEPORT. / What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job! / First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say! / You're to deliver a package to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT. / What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job! / First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime! / Now, my friend, where are we bound?$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? Well, PEEKO owes her life to you. / You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail!$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHere
text: Oh, dear, dear. Aren't your POKéMON exhausted? / If you'd like, rest up here. That's a fine idea! You should do that.$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourTimeRestUp
text: That's right. Take your time and rest up!$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTiredTakeAnotherRest
text: Oh, dear, dear. Are your POKéMON still tired? / You should take another rest here. That's a fine idea. You should do that.$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedToBeShy
text: Is that so? You don't need to be shy about it.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
text: I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC… I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS… / Do you want a FOSSIL? / But the FOSSILS around these parts all belong to me… None for you… / If you can't bear to go without a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there are boulders and sand that may hide FOSSILS…$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
text: You found a FOSSIL, didn't you? That's so nice… It's so dreamy… / DEVON's researcher can revive complete fossils from every ancient era. / The machine handles one at a time, but you may return with every kind.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_FossilsAreWonderful
text: You brought an ancient POKéMON back! Perhaps fossils are meant to awaken… / DEVON can revive any others you find.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
text: Oh... Be careful! I was digging when the wall fell into an enormous cavern. / With the HEAT BADGE, TING-LU can appear in the DESERT UNDERPASS. / It also connects to SANDSTREWN RUINS. With the BALANCE BADGE, ZYGARDE can appear on the ruins' B1F. / Each is a 1% wild encounter in its habitat. SWEET SCENT raises that chance to 25%.$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
text: That RUSTURF TUNNEL there… / At first, we had a huge work crew boring through rock with the latest machinery. But, we had to stop. / It turns out that we would have had a negative effect on wild POKéMON in the area. / So, we've got nothing to do but loll around here doing nothing.$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
text: There's a man digging his way to VERDANTURF all by his lonesome. He's desperate to get through. / He says that if he digs little by little without using machines, he won't disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid harming the natural environment. / I wonder if he made it through yet.$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVerdanturfWithoutTunnel
text: To get to VERDANTURF without using this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT, then travel through MAUVILLE.$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelHasGoneThrough
text: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF has gone through! / Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough, dreams do come true.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggOffer
text: MEGA KANGASKHAN fights with its child. Their Ability is PARENTAL BOND. / Leave two compatible adult POKéMON here, then hatch the EGG they produce. / I'll give you a KANGASKHANITE! DITTO in the grass can help you breed. / Want this TOGEPI EGG as a gift? This gift won't count for the stone.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggReceived
text: Take TOGEPI along on your adventure. / For the stone, hatch an EGG produced by two POKéMON you leave here.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggAfter
text: Leave two compatible POKéMON here, then hatch the EGG they produce. / One is enough for a KANGASKHANITE! Gift EGGS, including TOGEPI, don't count.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HatchReward
text: You raised an EGG from two parents! Now you've helped their family grow. / KANGASKHAN's child grows brave enough to fight beside its mother. / Their PARENTAL BOND lets the child follow up its mother's attacks. / This KANGASKHANITE is yours. Keep it for a KANGASKHAN from the SAFARI ZONE.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_RewardAfter
text: KANGASKHAN and its child battle together when it Mega Evolves. / You'll find KANGASKHAN in the SAFARI ZONE. Take good care of them!$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HatchRewardBagFull
text: Make room in your BAG. I'll keep your KANGASKHANITE safe until then.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggDeclined
text: The EGG will be safe here until you change your mind.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggNoRoom
text: Your party is full. Make one open slot, then return for the EGG.$

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_OvalCharmGift
text: If you ever want to breed POKéMON, this OVAL CHARM helps EGGS turn up.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome
text: What, are you coming? Come and get some, then!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
text: Grah, keelhaul it all! / The hostage POKéMON turned out to be a useless little bird, and now I'm stuck in a tunnel to nowhere! / Hey! You! You want the package? Come and take it from DONDOZO!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to a dead end!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
text: This is plain not right… / The BOSS told me this would be a slick-and-easy job to pull. / All I had to do was steal some package from DEVON. / Tch! You want it back that badly, take it!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_DevonPartsSentToPC
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the DEVON PARTS were sent to your PC.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_DevonPartsNoRoom
text: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. Make room, then take the DEVON PARTS.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe
text: PEEKO! Am I glad to see you're safe!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
text: PEEKO owes her life to you! / They call me MR. BRINEY. And, you are? / … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … / Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}! I sincerely thank you! / Now, if there's anything that troubles you, don't hesitate to tell me! / You can usually find me in my cottage by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS. / Come, PEEKO, we should make our way home. / PEEKO: Pihyoh!$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
text: … … / Why can't they keep digging? Is the bedrock too hard? / My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF TOWN just beyond here… / If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were joined by this tunnel, I could visit her every day… / But this… What am I to do?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf
text: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF, you need to go to DEWFORD, then pass through SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
text: Wow! You shattered that boulder blocking the way. / To show you how much I appreciate it, I'd like you to have this HM.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
text: That HM registers STRENGTH. / With the HEAT BADGE, a party member able to learn STRENGTH can move large boulders. / It needn't keep the move in its battle set.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
text: WANDA! Now I can see you anytime! / WANDA: That's…wonderful. / Please, take some rest at my home.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
text: On the other side of this rock… My boyfriend is there. / He… He's not just digging the tunnel to come see me. / He works his hands raw and rough for the benefit of everyone.$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
text: What do you call a wild man up in the mountains? A mountain man, right? / So why don't they call a POKéMON in the mountains a mountain POKéMON?$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat
text: My POKéMON… Ran out of power…$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle
text: They halted development here to protect POKéMON, right? There's a feel-good story!$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
text: All sorts of beings wander the slopes of MT. PYRE… / There is no telling what may happen. Take this. It's for your own good.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
text: Have a POKéMON hold that CLEANSE TAG. / It will help ward off wild POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
text: Did you come to pay your respect to the spirits of departed POKéMON? / You must care for your POKéMON a lot. / This mountain changes some evolutions. Level QUILAVA here at Lv. 36 or higher for Hisuian TYPHLOSION. / Level RUFFLET here at Lv. 54 or higher for Hisuian BRAVIARY. Elsewhere, both grow into their usual forms.$

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon
text: This is the final resting place of my ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty
text: Memories of my darling SKITTY… My eyes overflow thinking about it.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
text: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the ground here and there. / I didn't notice and took a tumble from the floor above.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro
text: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON? You came along after me! You're rude!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat
text: Ayieeeeh! I'm sorry, forgive me, please!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle
text: People don't come here often, so I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
text: LUKE: We're here on a dare. / Heheh, if I show her how cool I am, she'll fall for me. I know it! / I know! I'll cream you and show her how cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeDefeat
text: LUKE: Whoopsie!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle
text: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay! I'm right here by your side. We'll make it through this dare!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
text: LUKE: If you want to take me on, bring some more POKéMON. / If you don't, I won't be able to show off to my girl how cool I am!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
text: DEZ: I came here on a dare with my boyfriend. / It's really scary, but I'm with my boyfriend. It's okay. / I know! I'll get my boyfriend to look cool by beating you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezDefeat
text: DEZ: Waaaah! I'm scared!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle
text: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't care if we lose!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
text: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you should bring at least two POKéMON. / My boyfriend's strong. Just one POKéMON won't do at all.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro
text: You are an unfamiliar sight… Depart before anything befalls you!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahDefeat
text: Hmm… You're durable.$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
text: Our family has been TRAINERS here since my great-grandmother's time… / It is my duty to protect this mountain…$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderIntro
text: Kiyaaaaah! I'm terrified!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderDefeat
text: Nooooooo! I lost my wits!$

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
text: I get freaked out every time I see anything move… / I shouldn't have come here to train…$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
text: Teacher… Please watch over my progress!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
text: Teacher… Please forgive me!$

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
text: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests here, will never find true peace…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
text: I love all things horrifying… It's like a disease… / When I'm here… I shiver with fear…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaDefeat
text: Losing, I dislike…$

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
text: I want to see dreadful things… I can't leave… / Stay… Won't you stay with me?$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro
text: When I'm here… A curious power flows into me…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieDefeat
text: The power is ebbing away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle
text: Perhaps the power is from the spirits of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
text: Fufufu… I lost the match, but… I have this little ability… / Without ever laying my hands on your POKéNAV… Hiyah!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
text: Behind you… What is it…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchDefeat
text: Something faded away…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch
text: The POKéMON at rest here… Sometimes, they play…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro
text: Have you lost your bearings? Have no fear for I am here!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricDefeat
text: Weren't you lost?$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
text: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER would be panicked and easy to beat. / It's dirty and I won't try it again…$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntDormant
text: PECHARUNT waits here. Earn the MIND BADGE and catch OKIDOGI, MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI to challenge it.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntNeedsPartner
text: The three masks belong to OKIDOGI, MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI. / Catch all three, then return here. They do not need to travel with you.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntAwakens
text: The three masks flare! A poisoned mist spills from the tombstone--PECHARUNT!$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntQuiet
text: The tombstone is still. Three faded masks record the trial you completed.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Want the HIDEOUT's secret? Then you go through me and my SHARPEDO first!$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: I can't win at all lately…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: The secret? There's a submarine at the far end. Or… there was. Kekeke.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Fuel loaded A-OK! Snacks loaded A-OK! / Only thing left on my checklist is KO one meddler. That's you.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: That's… not how the checklist went.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Humph! My real job was to slow you down, and I did. The sub's gone.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: Yawn… Guard duty in a cave with no sea view. I'll take you on just to wake up.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Yawn… oh. I lost. Figures.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: Careful running around in here. The others aren't as sleepy as me.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
text: Hey! Honest question. Whose uniform is cooler, ours or MAGMA's? / …Right answer. Now battle me anyway.$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
text: I lost in a cool way, at least…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
text: Good uniform, you look fine even when you lose. That's my whole philosophy.$

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
text: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted on the hull. / This is the submarine TEAM AQUA stole in SLATEPORT! / TEAM AQUA must have gone ashore here.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
text: Hey! I remember your face! / If you're here, it must mean that you're about to mess with us again! / A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA? / I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years! / You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA! / Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP. / That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
