text: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA? / I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years! / You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA! / Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP. / That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: This cavern changes direction with every current. Turn back while you still can.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: You made the shifting floor look fixed…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: ARCHIE is farther below. Every room from here is meant to misdirect pursuit.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: The submarine found one narrow route in. My formation seals it behind us.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: You opened the route again…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: The stolen submarine is already deeper. You are following its pressure trail.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Who are you? How did you even get down here without the sub?$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Lost it… and I'm lost.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: I can't find the way out. I'm not scared. Don't get me wrong!$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Who are you? Where do you think you're going? Not past TOXAPEX.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: I failed to win. Twice today.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: My partner left the map in the sub. How's that for useless?$

label: CaveOfOrigin_1F_Text_CarbinkStuck
text: This CARBINK is guarding an old ladder. / Its crystals echo with the energy of eight BADGES. Come back when they shine.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
text: The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE… / I'm getting stage fright…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
text: I couldn't do a thing…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
text: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
text: Your relationship is based on solid trust.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
text: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
text: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
text: That's the way!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
text: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
text: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
text: I've never met anyone like you before.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
text: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
text: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
text: Whoa! Wonderful!$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
text: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD. / But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far. / Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
text: I trained together with my whole family, every one of us! I'm not losing to anyone!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
text: Better than my family?! Is that possible?!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
text: I was better than everyone in my family. I've never lost before… / I've lost my confidence… Maybe I'll go home…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
text: I'd heard that there was a tough little kid around. Do they mean you?$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
text: The little shrimp is tough!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
text: The rumors I heard, that tough little kid is from PETALBURG CITY.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
text: You must be getting a little tired.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
text: No signs of tiring at all!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
text: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE are long and grueling challenges. Beware of fatigue!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
text: You shouldn't get complacent just because you have a lot of GYM BADGES. / There's always going to be someone who's better than you!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
text: You're better than me!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
text: Gaze on your collected BADGES and remember the TRAINERS you've faced.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
text: I've come this far, but the tension's giving me awful stomach pain…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
text: Ooh… It hurts…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
text: I can't help getting all tense knowing that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE. / It's all I can do to feign calm.$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
text: The elite among the elite gather in this cave. / How are you finding it?$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
text: Not rattled in the least bit!$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
text: You do have guts! I like that! Keep it going!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
text: What's so funny about having my inner tube aboard the ship?$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
text: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
text: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS while hanging on to an inner tube!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
text: Isn't it fun here? I get excited just being here!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
text: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm taking a look around. / Hmhm… There appear to be other cabins…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
text: What on earth would compel you to come here? You must be curious!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
text: Not just curious, but also strong…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
text: The man next door… / He says he's just sightseeing, but I don't know about that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
text: You're such a tough TRAINER! Let me register you as a memento!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
text: What on earth would compel you to come back? You must really be curious!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
text: Aren't you too strong?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
text: I'm sure that man's up to something! He just acts so suspiciously!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
text: Waaah! I've been found! …Huh?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
text: Oh, you're not my mom.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
text: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran. Keep it a secret where I am!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
text: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS always bring our POKéMON. How about a quick battle?$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
text: Whoops, I'm sunk!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
text: The ship's bottom has sunk into the depths. / If a POKéMON knew how to go underwater, we might make some progress…$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
text: Yay! It's a ship!$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked. / “STORAGE” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
text: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the STORAGE KEY. / The inserted KEY stuck fast, but the door opened.$

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
text: The door is open.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
text: DAN: While searching for treasures, we discovered a TRAINER!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
text: DAN: We couldn't win even though we worked together…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
text: DAN: We can't find any treasures… I wonder if someone got them already?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
text: KIRA: Oh? We were searching for treasures. But we discovered a TRAINER instead!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
text: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
text: KIRA: Where could the treasures be? / I've already decided what I'm buying when we find the treasures!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
text: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry! I'm going to register you for that!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
text: DAN: We've been searching for treasures all this time. / Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. Let us show you, okay?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
text: DAN: You're strong, as usual!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
text: DAN: We can't find any treasures, we lose at POKéMON… / I want to go home… But if I say that, she gets all angry with me…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
text: KIRA: Oh? We meet again! / Just like us, you still haven't given up searching for treasures, have you? / Want to make it so the loser has to give up searching?$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
text: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
text: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise our POKéMON some more and we find the treasures here!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
text: I'm not good at swimming, but I am good at battles!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
text: Oops. That didn't go very well.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
text: Walking around barefoot in this ship is kind of gross.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
text: Strength and compassion… Those are a TRAINER's treasures!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
text: Ah, there is something about you that sparkles.$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
text: In a cabin somewhere on board, I saw something sparkle.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
text: Hey! No hood, no business here. / I joined MAGMA because my town floods every spring. Solid ground, that's all I ever asked for. Now beat it!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat
text: Aiyiyi… My hood and my pride, both.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattle
text: Go on, then. Just… if you see MAXIE, ask him if the ground is worth this.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Hold it! You think I'll just let you stroll past a CLAYDOL and a GARBODOR?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Ooh wow! Okay. I concede.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Honestly, I only signed up for the dental plan. Don't tell the ADMINS.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: An intruder! SCRAFTY, it's a real fight for once, not another drill!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: Graaah! Even the drills didn't go like that!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: I've already lost. Do I have to keep running laps around this rock?$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: Oh, oh! Nobody told me anyone would actually get this far!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Mutter… mutter…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: I'm not much of a battler. I'm in it for the volcano. It's really pretty.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
text: Guard posting next to the lava. My left ear's been cooking for an hour. / At least fighting you means I can move.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Defeat
text: Heat exhaustion. Definitely the heat.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle
text: Do you think it's weird that we wear hoods inside a volcano? Be honest.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
text: MAXIE offers a world people can predict, build on, and pass to their children. / AQUA rejects it. You question it. I will defend it.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat
text: Your uncertainty outplayed my order…$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
text: I still believe MAGMA's question matters. I am less certain our answer is complete.$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
text: You found the ROOT FOSSIL. / If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground around it will likely crumble away… / Take the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeftRootFossilAlone
text: {PLAYER} left the ROOT FOSSIL alone.$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
text: You found the CLAW FOSSIL. / If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground around it will likely crumble away… / Take the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?$

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeaveClawFossilAlone
text: {PLAYER} left the CLAW FOSSIL alone.$

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
text: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo. / It's a POKéMON brand moving and delivery service.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
text: SCOTT: Well, hi, hi! {PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / Something's come up, so I have to disembark, but am I glad to see you! / Congratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION! / There's a place I'd like to invite someone like you. / It's the… BATTLE FRONTIER! / What's the place like? You'll understand when you see it! / I've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN about this. / The next time you take a ferry, you should be able to sail to the BATTLE FRONTIER. / Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you at the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
text: This ferry is built to plow through fast-running currents. / We hope you enjoy your voyage with us. Feel free to explore the ship.$

label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
text: We hope you enjoy your voyage on our ferry.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
text: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.$

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
text: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
text: It'll be some time before we make land, I reckon. / You can rest up in your cabin if you'd like. Your cabin's No. 2. / The bed in there is soft and plushy. I can attest to how comfy it is!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
text: We've arrived!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
text: Go visit other cabins. TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will be itching to battle.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
text: Enjoy your cruise!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
text: The horizon spreads beyond the porthole.$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
text: MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / They made me honorary captain of the S.S. TIDAL! / You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now! / You know, I retired once before, but when I saw this majestic ship… / Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping soul as a sailor!$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
text: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
text: Cabin 1$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
text: Cabin 2$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
text: Cabin 3$

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
text: Cabin 4$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
text: This is the BATTLE DOME! Your path to the invincible superstar!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
text: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! Seek out the toughest POKéMON!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
text: BATTLE PIKE / CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT RECEPTION Central arena: BATTLE TOWER$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
text: This is the BATTLE TOWER. / TRAINERS bring their best-raised POKéMON for elimination-style matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I confirm your ferry pass?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
text: Your ferry pass is not registered. / I'm terribly sorry. / You need a registered pass to board the ferry.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: The attendant confirmed your ferry pass. / Perfect! That's all you need! / And where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
text: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
text: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
text: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER, but I can't find it even though I have a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER. / This place is just too big!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
text: I wanted to take a challenge as soon as I arrived here. / But on the way, I got seasick… Urrrrp…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
text: It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know? / Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here. / That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
text: Hey, bro... We need six Pokémon for the CIRCUIT. / Let's visit the CENTER and finish our team first.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
text: That big fellow showed me how to prepare a set at the CENTER. / He said the team still needs to be ours. Fair enough!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
text: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. Its desk also enters the CIRCUIT. / Who prepares all those opposing teams? I'd like to compare notes!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
text: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE PIKE because of SEVIPER… / B-but I came all the way here, so I will try to conquer everything! …Shudder…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
text: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three! / … … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
text: I won! I'll register at the PIKE and start another Circuit run!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
text: I lost. Maybe that's my cue to review my team before the CIRCUIT.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
text: I came to fish instead of battle. / I'll try the water and see what bites. A good partner can be its own reward.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
text: I'm going to keep battling until I beat my best Circuit streak!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
text: Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME? / I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
text: Grandpa, over here! The BATTLE DOME is here! Go get 'em, Grandpa!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
text: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me! / But where is the entrance?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
text: There used to be nothing here not all that long ago. / But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
text: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER! / I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
text: Munch, munch… / It looks like this square's filled with tough people. / Munch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
text: Crunch, munch… / A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE. / She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way. / Crunch, munch… / She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me. / It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough. / Crunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
text: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing! / Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
text: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft! / That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you! / The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
text: Oh, shush! Keep that racket down! / You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER! / The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
text: Those people squabbling over there… / It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too. / They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too. / But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament. / They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER. / Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every day now.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
text: I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER. / It must be adorable. I'm sure of it… / Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
text: The RANKING HALL is near the BATTLE TOWER. / Its current displays show your CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT run, best recorded run, and total wins.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
text: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near the BATTLE TOWER. / The Battle Points you have earned in the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged for fabulous prizes there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
text: I'm your guide to the basic rules that are common to all the challenges offered by the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
text: What would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
text: All the challenges at the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities come in two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
text: The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON up to and including Level 50. / Please keep in mind, however, that no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 50. / This course is the entry level for battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER. / To begin, we hope you will challenge this course.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
text: The Open Level course places no limit on the levels of POKéMON entering challenges. / The levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON. / However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 60.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
text: Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take on the challenges at all facilities. / EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON, however, are not permitted. / The numbers of POKéMON required for challenges will depend on the facility. / At all facilities, however, two or more of the same kind of POKéMON are not permitted.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
text: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not be holding the same kind of item. / Please make sure that all POKéMON entering a challenge are holding different items.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
text: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
text: Which would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
text: There are seven facilities at the BATTLE FRONTIER. / TRAINERS who gain recognition for their abilities may be rewarded with symbols from each of the facilities. / To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need to defeat other TRAINERS in a row, and may need to win events repeatedly. / It's certainly not easy to win symbols. I wish you the best of luck!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
text: Battle recordings are not offered at this BATTLE FRONTIER. / Your FRONTIER PASS instead tracks symbols, BATTLE POINTS, and your challenge records.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
text: Battle Points are rewards given to TRAINERS who battled outstandingly at the BATTLE FRONTIER. / You may trade in your Battle Points for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_CurrentFrontierPass
text: Your FRONTIER PASS keeps your TRAINER CARD, BATTLE POINTS, and historical SYMBOL records. / The record boards show your current CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT results.$

text: CELEBI has been slipping between the trees. With the STONE BADGE, you can find it in this grove's grass. / It has a 1% encounter chance. SWEET SCENT raises it to 25%.$

label: SandstrewnRuins_Text_Archaeologist
text: Every fossil here records a different answer to survival. Take them; build. / Below us, cells of green light wait for the guardian of the land.$

label: ScorchedSlab_B2F_Text_Warden
text: The slab is a lock between two fires. / HEATRAN guards the earth below. A white dragon answers only after time itself.$

label: VerdanturfMeadow_Text_Warden
text: DEERLING graze among these flowers. They evolve into SAWSBUCK at Lv. 34. / A SUN STONE used on PETILIL in this meadow yields Hisuian LILLIGANT. Use it elsewhere for the usual form.$
